object: M99-STREET-GLIDE-001, a provider-order scene resolver and bounded natural-border image-gradient registration kernel.
mechanism: The scene resolver consumes the exact public-demo source rows and optional admissible scene metadata, preserves the frozen provider order, rejects unhealthy, empty, stale, distant, misdirected, rights-deficient, generated, modeled, or incomplete candidates, and returns the first eligible provider scene or an explicit map-only hold with every provider attempt retained. The registration kernel consumes a source image and authored normalized polyline, computes deterministic grayscale Sobel gradients, searches only along each local line normal within a bounded radius, proposes the strongest admissible edge-aligned point, preserves every original and no-snap point, and emits displacement, gradient, alignment, image, candidate, method, authority, and claim receipts without identifying the physical feature.

Implements bounded normal-direction Sobel edge search, no-snap preservation, displacement and strength gates, original and proposed point custody, image and candidate digests, and a physical-feature non-claim.

Exercises provider precedence, lower-provider fallback, generated rejection, stale, distance, heading and rights rejection, map-only mode, prohibited-key refusal, deterministic scene selection, synthetic edge snapping, no-snap, displacement hold, radius bounds, and portable deterministic receipts.
